steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Gasp—These doctors are quite strong.

steps.speaker: Ted
steps.content: These people used to be gangsters in Syndicate and were taken in by SALVA and transformed into armed doctors.

steps.speaker: Ted
steps.content: It'll be difficult to pry intelligence out of them.
He steps forward and yanks up the surviving doctor, ignoring his howls and dragging him over to a seriously injured nurse. Seeing his injured companion completely throws him into a panic.

steps.speaker: SALVA Doctor
steps.content: Laura, Laura, are you okay?! Get off me, you bastard! Laura!

steps.speaker: Ted
steps.content: Is she called Laura? Poor thing. She's on her death bed now. If you can answer my questions, I'll let you save her.

steps.speaker: SALVA Doctor
steps.content: Go to *** hell, you ***!!!
Bang—
Ted shoots the nurse in the leg, who lets out a wretched shriek.

steps.speaker: SALVA Doctor
steps.content: Stop!!!

steps.speaker: Ted
steps.content: Where is the Sinner you took in yesterday?

steps.speaker: SALVA Doctor
steps.content: Sh-she's in the <color=#fb9259>basement</color>. A-Anne, the head nurse, sent her down there herself.

steps.speaker: Ted
steps.content: Then?

steps.speaker: SALVA Doctor
steps.content: I-I don't know. I'm not allowed to go down there. I-It's their...

steps.speaker: Ted
steps.content: What did the Sinner have with her? Did she say anything?

steps.speaker: SALVA Doctor
steps.content: No, I don't know. I didn't get close to her. Really! No! Please!! Don't shoot!!!

steps.speaker: SALVA Doctor
steps.content: I heard her saying things like "inheritance... She's found something... Something about power..." That's all I heard. I know nothing, but I've told you everything I heard.

steps.speaker: Ted
steps.content: "<color=#fb9259>Inheritance</color>"... Hahaha! I knew she had it!

steps.speaker: Ted
steps.content: Did you notify the Legion of this? I know your medical director is friends with the Legion.

steps.speaker: SALVA Doctor
steps.content: No, I don't know. The medical director <color=#fb9259>Iron</color> is away and hasn't returned yet, so we can't reach her.

steps.speaker: Ted
steps.content: Very well. Did you hear that, Chief? It's this "inheritance" that can control Mania and set off this crisis.

steps.speaker: Ted
steps.content: Even the Legion wants it. We have to get it as soon as possible and must not let it fall into the hands of others.

steps.speaker: SALVA Doctor
steps.content: No... Please, Laura... is in so much pain, please...
Ted remembers he had agreed to let them go, then he aims his gun at Laura.

steps.speaker: Ted
steps.content: She's lost too much blood. This is how I'll save her. Don't worry. I have good aim.

steps.speaker: SALVA Doctor
steps.content: No!!!
Bang—The bullet misses. A shadow shifts his shooting.
Hecate acted on your orders. You failed to stop the first shot, but you won't allow him to make the second shot.

steps.speaker: Choice
options: We've got the intel. It's enough.

steps.speaker: Ted
steps.content: ...This is how we do things in Syndicate, Chief. The enemy will never take it easy on us.

steps.speaker: Ted
steps.content: If he goes back and leaks intel about you, then SALVA will not let you off easily.

steps.speaker: Ted
steps.content: Chief, you are too kind... but Syndicate has no room for such kindness.

steps.speaker: Ted
steps.content: If he goes back and leaks intel about you, then SALVA will not let you off easily.

steps.speaker: Ted
steps.content: I know them. I know what SALVA wants and what they will do. I know it all, and it's disgusting!
As he speaks, a grenade flies over from behind and blows up the SALVA ambulance.
Flames rise from the explosion, in which are several moving shadows. They suddenly dash out.

steps.speaker: Monster
steps.content: Roaaahhh—!!!

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: An ambush?

steps.speaker: Ted
steps.content: See, Chief. This is SALVA. They collect these monsters on the battlefield and create them in the hospital.

steps.speaker: Ted
steps.content: <color=#fb9259>Corruptor</color>—Remember this name. They are more powerful and dangerous than those pathetic Maniatic gangsters.
